title: Perceptual Characterization of Soundscapes in Residential Areas

findings.antecedent: 12 perceptual attributes of soundscapes
findings.consequent: four soundscape dimensions (adverse, reposing, affective, expressionless)
findings.mechanism: Principal component analysis revealed underlying dimensions of soundscape perception.
findings.source: Abstract and Perceived Quality of Soundscapes section
findings.quote: Four components were extracted and labeled adverse, reposing, affective, and expressionless (Table 1).

findings.mechanism: The attribute 'Disturbing' strongly contributes to the 'Adverse' soundscape dimension.

stimuli.description: soundscapes at 6 listening places in residential areas (apartments facing trafficked streets and yards), listened to for 30 seconds each.

tables.description: Component analysis of 12 perceptual attributes, showing factor loadings on 4 components (Adverse, Reposing, Affective, Expressionless).
Component analysis of soundscapes, showing factor loadings for outdoor and indoor soundscapes on 2 components each.

limitations: The two analyses (outdoor and indoor soundscapes) do not take into account the interindividual variation in attribute profiles.
